RF-F001.description: Formal Phase 2 RF conditions: chip area is Pareto objective without hard cap; HV/HQ series and physical constraints retained.

RF-F002.description: Physical limits updated: chip neighbor k<=0.15, nonstrong nominal zero and sensitivity<=0.03, PCB pairs<=0.15, chip-PCB zero, PCB L<=2nH; variable C up to 2, each 0..1.5pF Q50 unrestricted positions; LQW04 Q33.

RF-T001.description: Three ground-shunt variable C; Phase 2 comparison only; exact three-branch layout.

RF-T002.description: Two ground shunts plus one non-ground bridge variable C; not series; Phase 2 comparison only.

RF-T003.description: Two variable C, one GND shunt and one non-ground bridge; 30dB H2/H3 Phase 2 study only, no main-path series variable C.

RF-T004.description: Phase 2 trial allowing up to three variable C branches with all other RF-F002 conditions unchanged.
